description: This file contains the implementation of a tuned blocked bloom filter class, including methods for adding elements, checking containment, and internal regression calculations for false positive rate adjustments.

classes.name: BlockedBloomFilter
classes.description: A class implementing a tuned blocked bloom filter with methods for adding elements, checking for containment, and internal regression for false positive rate tuning.

methods.name: BlockedBloomFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the bloom filter with a specified capacity and false positive rate, performing regression to adjust the rate.

methods.name: RegressFpRate
methods.description: Calculates an adjusted false positive rate based on polynomial regression coefficients.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element identified by GrainId to the bloom filter.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an element identified by GrainId is possibly in the bloom filter.

methods.name: GetBlockIndex
methods.description: Calculates the block index for a given hash.

methods.name: ComputeMask1
methods.description: Computes the first mask for a hash value.

methods.name: ComputeMask2
methods.description: Computes the second mask for a hash value.
